description: Opens a Stripe Checkout session for one dataset and returns the payment URL plus the session id. Give the URL to the user to pay (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). After payment Stripe emails them a permanent download link; use check_order with the session id to confirm and fetch it. Does not charge anything by itself.

email.description: Buyer email, if known — prefills Checkout and is where the download link is sent

name: create_checkout
title: Create a checkout link
